_doc: Descricoes dos monstros do Campo de Treino (GDD 10.3, 17.7). stages.<n>.desc = texto (geracao); stages.<n>.evolve = instrucao de EDICAO a partir do estagio anterior. attack = pose de ataque (edicao por direcao).

prank_whirlwind.attack: spinning faster and lunging forward, leaves and dust flying outward, mischievous angry eyes

1.desc: a small mischievous whirlwind spirit made of swirling dry orange and brown leaves and golden dust, a tiny red knitted cap spinning on top, two bright playful eyes peeking out of the swirl, no arms, no legs, the swirl tapers into a thin twist of wind touching the ground

2.evolve: Make this creature evolve into a bigger, wilder and more menacing whirlwind: a taller spiraling column of dry leaves, twigs and small red pebbles, a bigger red cap with a little tassel, sly narrowed eyes, a few small stones orbiting it. Still charming, but clearly stronger.

3.evolve: Make this creature evolve into a towering giant whirlwind boss: a huge spiraling tornado of golden leaves, red earth dust and broken branches, a large red cap flapping on top, fierce glowing eyes, a curl of grey smoke puffing from one side like pipe smoke, many leaves orbiting it. Epic, powerful and menacing, but with the same playful face design.

enchanted_firefly.attack: shooting a burst of glowing yellow light forward from its tail, wings spread wide

1.desc: an enchanted firefly insect, round dark green body, big shiny friendly eyes, four translucent pale wings, small antennae, its round abdomen glowing warm yellow light, hovering in the air

2.evolve: Make this creature evolve into a bigger lantern-bearer firefly: larger body, a much brighter glowing golden abdomen shaped like a paper lantern, longer wings with golden veins, glowing tips on the antennae, small glowing motes orbiting it, a slightly stern look. Clearly stronger but still charming.

3.evolve: Make this creature evolve into a majestic queen firefly boss: a large regal firefly with a crown-shaped crest on its head, four big wings with glowing golden patterns, a huge radiant golden-orange glowing abdomen, a trail of floating blue and yellow will-o-wisp lights around her. Epic and powerful, same face design.

stone_armadillo.attack: curled into a rolling ball of stone plates, charging forward

1.desc: a chubby armadillo with shell plates made of smooth reddish stone, small moss patches on the shell, big round shiny eyes, cute but slightly grumpy

2.evolve: Make this creature evolve into a bigger rock armadillo: shell plates of rough reddish boulders with glowing amber crystal shards growing from them, thicker moss, fierce frowning eyes, sturdy dark claws. Clearly stronger and more menacing, same face design.

3.evolve: Make this creature evolve into a gigantic mountain armadillo boss: its shell is like a small red rock mountain with grass and a small flowering yellow ipe tree growing on top, glowing amber eyes, huge claws, ancient and powerful. Epic, same face design.

fountain_serpent.attack: striking forward with its mouth open, water droplets splashing

1.desc: a small cute serpent with teal scales and golden spots, coiled like a spring, big shiny eyes, a tiny golden crest on its head, a few droplets of fountain water around it

trasgo_imp.attack: jumping forward with a playful kick, grinning

1.desc: a tiny mischievous goblin imp with a floppy red pointed cap, big pointy ears, a patched brown tunic, bare feet, a wide grin with a missing tooth

kasa_obake.attack: hopping forward and lashing out its long tongue

1.desc: a haunted old paper umbrella creature with one big eye in the middle of the canopy and a long red tongue, faded red and cream oiled paper, standing and hopping on a single wooden leg

trickster_tanuki.attack: swinging a big green leaf forward like a fan, mischievous grin

1.desc: a chubby raccoon dog trickster with brown and dark mask fur, a green leaf on its head, a round belly, a bushy striped tail, a mischievous grin

moss_troll.attack: swinging a heavy stone fist forward

1.desc: a small stout troll made of grey stone covered with green moss, a big round nose, tiny eyes, little mushrooms growing on its shoulders, grumpy expression, long arms

lindworm_hatchling.attack: lunging forward with jaws open and frosty breath

1.desc: a baby wingless dragon serpent with pale ice blue scales, two small front legs, small frosty spikes along its back, big curious eyes

griffin_chick.attack: pouncing forward with small talons out and beak open

1.desc: a baby griffin with an eagle head covered in fluffy cream and golden feathers, a small tawny lion cub body, tiny wings, big eyes

little_chimera.attack: pouncing forward with a tiny roar

1.desc: a small cute chimera: a tawny lion cub body, a little white goat head with small horns on its back, a green snake tail with a tiny snake head, playful expression

dune_scorpion.attack: striking forward with its curled stinger and raised pincers

1.desc: a sand colored scorpion the size of a dog with ochre armor plates, a curled stinger tail with a turquoise tip, raised pincers, big shiny eyes

sphinx_cub.attack: pouncing forward with a small roar, wings spread

1.desc: a sphinx cub: a small tawny winged lion cub wearing a striped blue and gold cloth headdress, calm wise eyes, folded feathered wings

puca_trickster.attack: headbutting forward with its curly horns

1.desc: a mischievous small black shaggy goat creature with curly horns and glowing golden eyes, long fur, a sly smile

lake_kelpie.attack: rearing up and kicking forward, water splashing

1.desc: a small water horse made of dark teal water, a flowing green seaweed mane, glowing green eyes, dripping water droplets

zmey_hatchling.attack: all three heads lunging forward, one breathing a small puff of fire

1.desc: a baby three-headed green dragon, each small head with a different expression, stubby little wings, a round belly, short tail

walking_hut.attack: kicking forward with one big chicken leg

1.desc: a tiny wooden log cabin with a thatched roof walking on two big yellow chicken legs, a glowing round window like an eye, a little smoke from its chimney

hopping_jiangshi.attack: hopping forward with both arms stretched out stiffly

1.desc: a comical stiff hopping undead creature from old folk tales, wearing a long dark teal robe with wide sleeves and a round flat black hat with a short brim, pale blue-green skin, arms stretched straight forward, a plain cloth strip hanging from the hat brim in front of its face, eyes closed, silly rather than scary

spirit_fox_cub.attack: pouncing forward with blue spirit fire flaring on its tails

1.desc: a small white fox cub with two fluffy tails tipped with soft blue spirit flames, big bright eyes

obsidian_iguana.attack: lunging forward with its mouth open, spikes raised

1.desc: an iguana made of glossy black obsidian stone with turquoise spikes along its back, glowing orange eyes

jaguar_cub.attack: pouncing forward with claws out and a playful snarl

1.desc: a jaguar cub with golden fur covered in black rosette spots, big paws, a playful snarl
